Premake 5.0.0-beta2 for Windows x64 (premake5 --version: "premake5 (Premake Build Script Generator) 5.0.0-beta2"),
https://github.com/premake/premake-core/releases/tag/v5.0.0-beta2: premake5.exe, with its symbols and the luasocket
and example modules it was built with. FRT.bat runs it; nothing builds it.

One change: premake5.exe's embedded manifest also gives the process the UTF-8 code page (activeCodePage, Windows 10
1903 and later), as every engine executable has (Core/Resources/Utf8CodePage.manifest). Premake's own file functions
take UTF-8, but as released its command line - and whatever Lua's io and os libraries hand the C runtime - is in the
system's ANSI code page, so a path with any character outside it (D:\Ігри 游戏 on an English system) arrived as '?'
and FRT.bat failed. With it, every path Premake reads, writes, runs or prints is UTF-8, and so are the files it writes
(vcxproj, the registry INI files). It was merged into the manifest the release has (asInvoker) with the Windows SDK's
manifest tool, in this directory:

  mt.exe -nologo -manifest ..\..\Core\Resources\Utf8CodePage.manifest -inputresource:premake5.exe;#1 -outputresource:premake5.exe;#1

The code is untouched (premake5.pdb still matches). Do the same to a newer premake5.exe before vendoring it.

SHA-256 before: AA37BB2C174CEA51BE381B3378A5B54406FC3339DBFA4AAEF9D50875E76B8C25
SHA-256 after:  59F2DB8C1BBABCB4A9A6CAEDB97FD5478CE78BF22D19681F4B42EAEF7E127149
